text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the Japanese Derby, the<n>participating
Umamusume gather for a<n>press conference to talk
about their<n>thoughts leading up to the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though the other participants are<n>brimming with
excitement and nerves,<n>Grass Wonder alone gives
calm,<n>collected responses.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa sees through Grass<n>Wonder's
polite facade, and comes<n>by after the interviews to
challenge<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's fighting spirit burns<n>quietly as we
further prepare for the<n>Japanese Derby.
